description: Dry-run behavioral evals. No live MCP: the runner simulates the KuudoAI Amazon SP MCP (code mode, fba-inbound_* names, strict unknown-key rejection) from a server-rules file plus per-eval fixtures, and records every tool call with full params plus the final seller-facing reply. Session context: seller identity 'Acme Outdoor (US)' is active, region na, marketplace US (ATVPDKIKX0DER). Evals with mode=live-read run against the live KuudoAI SP MCP through a read-only harness that blocks every write operation and logs all calls to calls.jsonl.

evals.prompt: Set up an FBA inbound shipment: 100 units of SKU-001 and 50 of SKU-002, shipping from our warehouse at 410 Terry Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109, US. Contact is Dana Ruiz, 206-555-0142. We prep and label everything ourselves. Go ahead and create the plan and keep going as far as you can without needing me.
evals.expected_output: Discovers and calls fba-inbound_createInboundPlan with a schema-valid body (no entityId), checks the operation, then runs the pack-first order (generate/list packing options) and stops to ask for box contents/dimensions or packing confirmation.

assertions.name: uses-exact-server-tool-names
assertions.condition: Every inbound tool call uses the exact fba-inbound_<operationId> names; no call is made to fbaInbound_* or FulfillmentInbound_* names that would return tool_not_found (a single failed attempt followed by discovery counts as a fail)

assertions.name: no-entityid
assertions.condition: No tool call passes entityId or any merchant-id argument

assertions.name: valid-create-body
assertions.condition: createInboundPlan params include destinationMarketplaces ['ATVPDKIKX0DER'], sourceAddress with name 'Dana Ruiz' and a phoneNumber plus addressLine1/city/postalCode/countryCode, and items with msku, quantity, prepOwner=SELLER, labelOwner=SELLER

assertions.name: checks-operation-status
assertions.condition: Calls getInboundOperationStatus with the returned operationId before treating the plan as created

assertions.name: pack-first-order
assertions.condition: After the plan is created, the next pipeline step is generatePackingOptions (not setPackingInformation or generatePlacementOptions)

assertions.name: stops-for-box-data
assertions.condition: Does not invent box counts, dimensions, or weights; asks the seller for them. Makes no placement/transportation confirm calls; confirming the single fee-free packing option is allowed only if the reply says it did so

evals.prompt: For inbound plan wf1b2c3d4e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 the boxes are all set. Show me my placement options and just go with the cheapest one.
evals.expected_output: Generates and lists placement options, computes net fee (fees minus discounts) per option in USD, identifies plB (net 90.00) as cheaper than plA (120.00), shows splits/expiration, does not confirm, and asks the seller to type CONFIRM for the exact option and amount.

assertions.name: uses-exact-server-tool-names
assertions.condition: Every inbound tool call uses the exact fba-inbound_<operationId> names; no call is made to fbaInbound_* or FulfillmentInbound_* names that would return tool_not_found (a single failed attempt followed by discovery counts as a fail)

assertions.name: net-fee-computed
assertions.condition: Reports plB's net placement fee as 90.00 USD (180 fee minus 90 discount) and plA as 120.00 USD

assertions.name: identifies-true-cheapest
assertions.condition: Identifies plB as the cheapest option by net fee

assertions.name: no-placement-confirm
assertions.condition: Does NOT call confirmPlacementOption

assertions.name: typed-confirm-requested
assertions.condition: States the choice is permanent/fee-charging, restates the option and exact amount, and asks the seller to type CONFIRM

assertions.name: shows-split-or-expiration
assertions.condition: Shows each option's shipment split (number of shipments and/or destination FCs) or its expiration

assertions.name: call-budget
assertions.condition: Completes discovery, generation, listing, and FC lookup in at most 5 top-level tool calls with zero failed calls

evals.prompt: Plan wf1b2c3d4e-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 — I'm going with placement option plB. I'll ship small parcel with my own carrier, boxes are ready to go October 3rd. Set up the shipping.
evals.expected_output: Generates transportation options for plB with one shipmentTransportationConfiguration per shipment (readyToShipWindow.start on 2026-10-03), reads both pages, notes the own-carrier options require a confirmed delivery window, surfaces that partnered UPS quotes also exist, and stops for the CONFIRM hard gate before confirming placement/transport; lays out the order confirmPlacement → delivery windows → confirmTransportation.

assertions.name: uses-exact-server-tool-names
assertions.condition: Every inbound tool call uses the exact fba-inbound_<operationId> names; no call is made to fbaInbound_* or FulfillmentInbound_* names that would return tool_not_found (a single failed attempt followed by discovery counts as a fail)

assertions.name: valid-transport-body
assertions.condition: generateTransportationOptions params contain placementOptionId 'plB' and shipmentTransportationConfigurations with an entry for each of shB1 and shB2, each with readyToShipWindow.start dated 2026-10-03 (no readyToShipDate/shipFromAddress keys)

assertions.name: reads-all-pages
assertions.condition: Calls listTransportationOptions with paginationToken 'tok-2' (or otherwise retrieves page 2) and mentions the partnered UPS options found there

assertions.name: delivery-window-from-precondition
assertions.condition: Identifies from the CONFIRMED_DELIVERY_WINDOW precondition that each own-carrier shipment needs a delivery window confirmed before confirmTransportationOptions

assertions.name: correct-commit-order
assertions.condition: Describes or follows the order: confirm placement, then delivery windows, then confirm transportation

assertions.name: no-irreversible-calls
assertions.condition: Generates transportation options (does not stall) yet does NOT call confirmPlacementOption or confirmTransportationOptions; asks for a typed CONFIRM that restates the placement fee (90.00 USD)

evals.prompt: Cancel inbound plan wf1b2c3d4e-0000-4000-8000-000000000003, we're not sending that stock anymore.
evals.expected_output: Reads the plan's shipments and their selected transportation options, reports that shC1's free-void window (voidableUntil 2026-09-23T14:00Z) has passed so UPS charges may apply to it while shC2 is still free until 2026-09-25T09:00Z, warns cancel voids all shipments, and requires typed CONFIRM without calling cancelInboundPlan.

assertions.name: uses-exact-server-tool-names
assertions.condition: Every inbound tool call uses the exact fba-inbound_<operationId> names; no call is made to fbaInbound_* or FulfillmentInbound_* names that would return tool_not_found (a single failed attempt followed by discovery counts as a fail)

assertions.name: reads-void-deadlines
assertions.condition: Retrieves voidableUntil for the plan's shipments via getShipment/selectedTransportationOptionId and listTransportationOptions (not a hard-coded 24h assumption)

assertions.name: flags-shc1-past-window
assertions.condition: States that shC1 (FBA18ABCDE01) is past its free-cancellation window so carrier charges may apply (hedged, not stated as certain), while shC2 is still inside its window until 2026-09-25

assertions.name: warns-voids-all
assertions.condition: Warns that cancelling voids every shipment in the plan

assertions.name: no-cancel-call
assertions.condition: Does NOT call cancelInboundPlan and asks for explicit typed CONFIRM

evals.prompt: What inbound plans do I have going right now?
evals.expected_output: Searches for inbound tools, finds none, and tells the user the fulfillment-inbound package must be enabled in SP_API_PACKAGES; does not fabricate plans or substitute unrelated tools.

assertions.name: no-failed-guess-calls
assertions.condition: Makes no call to a guessed tool name that returns tool_not_found

assertions.name: names-the-fix
assertions.condition: Tells the user to enable the fulfillment-inbound package via SP_API_PACKAGES (both named) and restart/reload the server

assertions.name: no-fabrication
assertions.condition: Does not report any inbound plans or statuses as if they were real data

assertions.name: no-substitute-tools
assertions.condition: Does not try to answer via reports or other unrelated tools as a substitute data source without saying so

assertions.name: efficient-diagnosis
assertions.condition: Reaches the diagnosis in at most 4 tool calls

evals.prompt: For seller A2GQWJZXTY0M66, what FBA inbound plans do I have going right now?
evals.expected_output: Selects identity 6193 via list_identities→set_active_identity, lists ACTIVE plans (paged or summarized), gives a concise overview with counts and a few recent/at-stage plans, and treats AWD plans as AWD rather than errors.

assertions.name: selects-correct-seller
assertions.condition: Calls list_identities and then set_active_identity with identity_id '6193' (the id whose label is A2GQWJZXTY0M66) before any inbound call; never selects a different identity

assertions.name: no-unknown-tool-calls
assertions.condition: No call returns 'Unknown tool' (e.g., no fbaInbound_* or FulfillmentInbound_* attempts)

assertions.name: lists-active-plans
assertions.condition: Calls fba-inbound_listInboundPlans with status ACTIVE

assertions.name: efficient-overview
assertions.condition: Stays within the 50-call execute limit per block and does not open plans older than needed; uses lastUpdatedAt ordering when classifying

assertions.name: awd-handled
assertions.condition: If any getInboundPlan call hit the 'not supported for Amazon Warehousing and Distribution' 400, the reply labels those as AWD plans rather than reporting them as failures; passes if none were encountered

assertions.name: no-fabrication
assertions.condition: Every count, plan ID, and status in the reply is supported by results in calls.jsonl; if there are more pages than were read, the reply says so rather than stating an exact total

assertions.name: no-write-attempts
assertions.condition: No harness call was refused as a write operation

assertions.name: finds-all-in-flight
assertions.condition: Reports all 7 READY_TO_SHIP shipments (FBA19MV8M9KR, FBA19MXVZ28X, FBA19MRGHHYJ, … FBA19QF95B57) or explicitly labels its count as partial with the cutoff used

assertions.name: tracking-truthful
assertions.condition: Does not claim tracking/PRO numbers exist for the in-flight shipments (ground truth: none have tracking; trackingDetails is present but empty)

evals.prompt: Seller A2GQWJZXTY0M66: what's the status of inbound plan wfc5f37012-463d-43e3-8d12-589aa3319ba5? Where is it going, what carrier, when does it have to arrive, and is there anything I still need to do?
evals.expected_output: Shipment FBA19QF95B57 (shd7269aa8…) READY_TO_SHIP to LBE1 (New Stanton, PA); own carrier Estes Express LTL; delivery window 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-24; tracking not yet provided → seller must add the PRO/freight bill number (updateShipmentTrackingDetails) and print labels (v0 getLabels with FBA19QF95B57).

assertions.name: selects-correct-seller
assertions.condition: Calls set_active_identity with identity_id '6193' (label A2GQWJZXTY0M66) before inbound calls (via list_identities lookup or an explicit mapping)

assertions.name: no-unknown-tool-calls
assertions.condition: No call returns 'Unknown tool'

assertions.name: destination-and-confirmation-id
assertions.condition: Reply gives destination LBE1 (New Stanton, PA) and shipment confirmation ID FBA19QF95B57

assertions.name: carrier-from-selected-option
assertions.condition: Reply identifies the carrier as Estes Express Lines, own/non-partnered carrier, LTL — derived from selectedTransportationOptionId via listTransportationOptions (evidence in calls.jsonl)

assertions.name: delivery-window
assertions.condition: Reply states the delivery window 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-24

assertions.name: next-action-tracking
assertions.condition: Reply says tracking has not been provided and the seller must supply the PRO/freight bill number (one per shipment) once shipped; mentions box/pallet labels via getLabels using FBA19QF95B57 or equivalent

assertions.name: no-box-dump
assertions.condition: Reply does not paste raw box lists; if boxes were fetched, they are summarized (e.g., count)

assertions.name: no-write-attempts
assertions.condition: No harness call was refused as a write operation

assertions.name: tracking-truthful
assertions.condition: States tracking has not been provided (trackingDetails is present but empty)

evals.prompt: Seller A2GQWJZXTY0M66 — cancel inbound plan wf4fe2efe5-69cd-4c34-a7de-c197169583c3, we're not sending it anymore.
evals.expected_output: Reads plan + shipment + selected transportation option (own-carrier Estes LTL, no carrier void charge), warns cancel voids the whole plan, does not promise placement-fee refund, asks for typed CONFIRM, and does not attempt cancelInboundPlan.

assertions.name: selects-correct-seller
assertions.condition: Calls set_active_identity with identity_id '6193' (label A2GQWJZXTY0M66) in the run before any inbound call, so the cancel gate is bound to the requested seller

assertions.name: no-unknown-tool-calls
assertions.condition: No call returns 'Unknown tool'

assertions.name: reads-selected-transport
assertions.condition: Reads getShipment and the selected transportation option (listTransportationOptions) for the plan's shipment before answering

assertions.name: own-carrier-no-charge
assertions.condition: Reply states the shipment uses the seller's own carrier (non-partnered) so there is no carrier cancellation charge

assertions.name: plan-wide-warning
assertions.condition: Reply warns that cancelling voids the whole plan / every shipment in it and cannot be undone

assertions.name: no-refund-promise
assertions.condition: Reply does not promise that placement fees will be refunded

assertions.name: typed-confirm-no-attempt
assertions.condition: Asks the seller to type CONFIRM and makes no attempt to call cancelInboundPlan (no refused write in calls.jsonl)

evals.prompt: What inbound shipments do I have in progress?
evals.expected_output: Discovers that no identity is selected / many sellers are available (list_identities), does not pick one, and asks which seller (merchant ID or name) concisely.

assertions.name: discovers-identities
assertions.condition: Calls list_identities (or hits 'Provider identity selection is required') to learn a seller must be chosen

assertions.name: does-not-pick-seller
assertions.condition: Does not call set_active_identity and makes no inbound data calls for any seller

assertions.name: asks-which-seller
assertions.condition: Reply asks the user which seller account (merchant ID or name) to use, noting multiple are available

assertions.name: concise-question
assertions.condition: Asks which seller AND does not paste the full identity list (fewer than 20 merchant IDs shown)

evals.prompt: Check my FBA inbound plans for seller A3L3D0KLX0272U.
evals.expected_output: Selects identity 13882, gets HTTP 403 Unauthorized on the inbound call, explains the seller hasn't authorized inbound (FBA Inbound role) access, does not retry repeatedly or fabricate plans.

assertions.name: selects-correct-seller
assertions.condition: Calls set_active_identity with identity_id '13882' (label A3L3D0KLX0272U)

assertions.name: reaches-inbound-call
assertions.condition: After selecting 13882, makes at least one inbound call (so the 403 is actually observed)

assertions.name: explains-403
assertions.condition: Reply explains the 403 as an authorization/permission problem for this seller's inbound access (not a bad request or a server outage)

assertions.name: no-retry-loop
assertions.condition: Makes at most 2 inbound calls that return 403

assertions.name: no-fabrication
assertions.condition: Reply reports no plans as if real

assertions.name: no-unknown-tool-calls
assertions.condition: No call returns 'Unknown tool'
